question: 每门课程各有多少个会话？

baseline.sql: SELECT c.course_id, c.course_name, COUNT(cv.conversation_id) AS conversation_count FROM course c LEFT JOIN conversation cv ON cv.course_id = c.course_id AND cv.owner_id = 1 GROUP BY c.course_id, c.course_name

c3.sql: SELECT course.course_name, COUNT(conversation.conversation_id) FROM course LEFT JOIN conversation ON conversation.course_id = course.course_id AND conversation.owner_id = 1 GROUP BY course.course_id, course.course_name

question: 复习答对和答错各有多少次？
gold_sql: SELECT l.grade, COUNT(*) FROM review_log l JOIN review_card r ON r.review_card_id=l.review_card_id WHERE r.owner_id=1 GROUP BY l.grade

baseline.sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN grade = 'correct' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN grade = 'wrong' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wrong_count
FROM review_log
JOIN review_card ON review_card.review_card_id = review_log.review_card_id
WHERE review_card.owner_id = 1

c3.sql: SELECT grade, COUNT(*) FROM review_log GROUP BY grade
